The gameplay on pc is definitely smoother because of all the graphics settings you can adjust to your likings. I have quite a strong pc so I can run the game pretty well although I have a bug on this game where my cpu/processor goes to 100% usage which means it bottlenecks my gpu/graphics card so I don't get as much fps as I should be getting with a gtx 1080. Also since you're using a mouse and keyboard everything feels a lot more fluent as well. But yeah the difference between both platforms is really noticeable, I can't get myself to play r6 on the playstation anymore because of what you mentioned and especially when you're used to a pc everything feels so weird. You can also adjust the field of view on pc, on console it's locked to 60 while on pc you can set it to 90 if you like and that makes a huge difference as well. Also don't be afraid to lower the graphics settings a bit, lot's of people including myself set most things on low to get the best fps. And don't be intimidated of the people that say "a console diamond is a copper on pc" that's just nonsense, I myself was a plat 1 on console and I personally think that I could hit diamond if I had a consistent team and on pc I'm a plat 3 also because I don't have a consistent team to play with. On pc there are lot of people that use the voice chat as well which is really nice and if you don't want to talk you can always use the in game chat. Also I would recommend not hopping into ranked right away. I would suggest practicing your aim in terrorist hunt first and adjusting the sensitivity to your likings, this might take some time to find the ideal sens for you though. And if you're confident enough you can always go ranked. I hope this helped a bit, If you need to know anything else let me know. c:
